title: Bear cub dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='92' rx='27' ry='5' fill='#3a2a5a' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='76' width='11' height='16' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <rect x='56' y='72' width='11' height='20' rx='5' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='92' rx='8' ry='4' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='65' rx='19' ry='18' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='12' ry='13' fill='#D2A679'/>

  <!-- left arm raised up -->
  <rect x='18' y='40' width='9' height='26' rx='4.5' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(-35 22 53)'/>
  <circle cx='17' cy='40' r='6' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <!-- right arm out to side -->
  <rect x='73' y='50' width='9' height='24' rx='4.5' fill='#8B5A2B' transform='rotate(25 77 62)'/>
  <circle cx='84' cy='53' r='6' fill='#A0522D'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='33' r='19' fill='#A0522D'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='18' r='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='34' cy='18' r='4.5' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='18' r='8' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='18' r='4.5' fill='#D2A679'/>

  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='10' ry='7.5' fill='#D2A679'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='3.5' ry='2.8' fill='#4A2C0A'/>
  <!-- mouth smiling -->
  <path d='M46 41 Q50 46 54 41' stroke='#4A2C0A' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='28' r='2.8' fill='#2E1A06'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='28' r='2.8' fill='#2E1A06'/>
  <circle cx='43' cy='27' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='27' r='1' fill='#FFFFFF'/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='36' cy='36' r='3' fill='#E88' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='36' r='3' fill='#E88' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- sparkles around -->
  <path d='M14 20 l2 4 l4 2 l-4 2 l-2 4 l-2 -4 l-4 -2 l4 -2 z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <path d='M86 30 l1.5 3 l3 1.5 l-3 1.5 l-1.5 3 l-1.5 -3 l-3 -1.5 l3 -1.5 z' fill='#FFD700'/>
  <path d='M74 14 l1.2 2.4 l2.4 1.2 l-2.4 1.2 l-1.2 2.4 l-1.2 -2.4 l-2.4 -1.2 l2.4 -1.2 z' fill='#FFD700'/>
</svg>
